Repository: the Round Companion monorepo, checked out read-only at commit e02167f in the current directory (the app is under apps/web: src/ is the client, convex/ the backend, convex/ai/prompts/library the prompts; infra/ holds the AWS stack; docs/ at the root).
Extra read-only folders you may use: handoff-docs, /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fqq-Desktop-Topflightapps-roundai/2a408671-6ff1-4104-9d24-9f97da7d0ee6/scratchpad/cr/review-evidence

Scenario OAT-02/S06 — Backend outbound calls to AI and email providers are all HTTPS

Requirements it checks:
- U2: All traffic is encrypted in transit. This includes the live-dictation audio stream and the backend's calls to the AI and email providers (Bedrock, Vertex, OpenAI, SES).

Given: convex/ at the UAT build; the aiProvider row the UAT deployment uses (provider, visionProvider); the Convex deployment's Integrations page (log streams, webhooks); and the scheme of these env values on the deployment, read by Tim (unset = SDK default https; values not copied into evidence beyond their scheme): SITE_URL, SPECODE_EMAIL_RELAY_URL, AUTH_EMAIL_PROVIDER, AWS_SES_REGION, OPENAI_BASE_URL, AWS_ENDPOINT_URL, AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_BEDROCK_RUNTIME, BETTER_AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS and any base-URL override the Google GenAI SDK reads
When: List every outbound endpoint the backend calls: Bedrock (AWS SDK, bedrock-runtime), Vertex (Google GenAI SDK), OpenAI chat completions and vision (api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions, selectable as provider 'openai' and visionProvider 'openai' in convex/ai/providers/index.ts), OpenAI transcription (api.openai.com/v1/audio/transcriptions), live-session key minting, SES (email.<region>.amazonaws.com), the Specode relay, SITE_URL, and any Convex log-stream or webhook destination. Record which provider and visionProvider the deployment's aiProvider row selects.
Then: Every endpoint is https://. Each env override above is unset or starts with https://. A path that is unused on the deployment is recorded as unused (AUTH_EMAIL_PROVIDER=ses, so the relay is unused).
Oracle: UAT OAT-02 Expected 'All traffic encrypted in transit' (scope per Q2). One http:// endpoint or env override in use = Fail, quoted with the file or variable. Which AI actually ran each step is S03 (3.9), not this review.

THE ORACLE WINS. The question below only scopes this scenario to what code can decide. If the question, or its pass/fail rule, ever reads differently from the Then/Oracle above, follow the Then/Oracle, give the verdict the oracle gives, and say where they differ in openQuestions.

Open questions the oracle defers to, with the oracle's default for each (do not settle them yourself):
- (none)

Gaps the matrix already records (use the id in a label only when the finding is exactly that gap):
- (none)

YOUR QUESTION (answer this, from the code):
List every outbound endpoint the backend (apps/web/convex) can call, with file:line and scheme: Bedrock (AWS SDK bedrock-runtime), Vertex (Google GenAI SDK), OpenAI chat completions / vision (selectable as provider 'openai' and visionProvider 'openai'), OpenAI transcription, the live-session key minting call, SES, the Specode email relay, SITE_URL use, and any other fetch() or SDK client. For each: is the URL hard-coded https, built from an env var (name it), or an SDK default? Record the env overrides Tim must read (their names) in notDecidableByCode.

pass = every hard-coded endpoint is https:// and every other one is an SDK default (https) or an env override
fail = any http:// endpoint in code

Other halves of this scenario that another lane or a person runs (do not judge them; if the code you read predicts one of them, report that as a finding labelled half:<name>, supports = pass or fail):
- half:env overrides on the deployment — CONFIG (Tim reads each scheme): "Each env override above is unset or starts with https://"
- half:unused paths on the deployment — CONFIG (Tim): "A path that is unused on the deployment is recorded as unused (AUTH_EMAIL_PROVIDER=ses, so the relay is unused)"

Not part of this verdict (other scenarios, or notes that decide nothing here):
- which AI actually ran each step is S03 (3.9)
- Convex log streams / webhooks (CONFIG)



Label every finding:
- new: a failing point the matrix does not already record (supports = fail)
- known:<id>: exactly one of the recorded gaps listed above
- pending:<id>: a failing point whose verdict the oracle hands to one of the open questions above
- half:<name>: a point about one of the other halves above
- context: background, not for or against the verdict

Answer with: verdict (pass | fail | pending | unsure), answer (a short paragraph a QA lead can read: what the code does and why that is the verdict; name the recorded gaps and open questions it touches), findings (each with claim, file, line, quote, supports = pass | fail | context, label), physicianImpact, openQuestions, notDecidableByCode.
